standard.summary: 控制不同噪声时间步（timestep）对 loss 的贡献权重。不同权重方案让训练聚焦于不同粒度的特征学习。
standard.effect: uniform = 所有时间步等权（最简单）；logit_normal = 中等噪声步权重更高（聚焦中频特征）；sigma_sqrt = 基于 sigma 值的平方根加权（聚焦高噪声步）。
standard.whenToUse: logit_normal 是 Anima/Flux 等新架构的推荐方案，平衡细节和结构学习。uniform 适合调试时使用（与基础实现最接近）。
standard.avoidWhen: 不了解各方案差异时，保持默认（logit_normal）即可，已经过调优。

optionDescriptions.sigma_sqrt: 偏高噪声，结构多、细节可能少。
optionDescriptions.logit_normal: 中噪声多一点，结构和细节比较匀。

standard_en.summary: Controls how much each noise timestep contributes to the loss. Different schemes point the run at features of different granularity.
standard_en.effect: uniform = every timestep weighs the same (simplest); logit_normal = mid-noise steps weigh more (focus on mid-frequency features); sigma_sqrt = weights follow the square root of sigma (focus on high-noise steps).
standard_en.whenToUse: logit_normal is the recommended scheme for newer architectures such as Anima and Flux; it balances detail against structure. uniform suits debugging, being closest to the plain implementation.
standard_en.avoidWhen: If you are unsure how the schemes differ, keep the default (logit_normal) -- it is already tuned.

optionDescriptions.sigma_sqrt: Leans towards high noise: more structure, possibly less detail.
optionDescriptions.logit_normal: A little more mid-noise, so structure and detail come out fairly even.

advanced.principle: 训练 loss = E_t[w(t) × ||ε_θ(x_t,t) - ε||²]。权重函数 w(t) 决定模型优化的优先方向：低噪声步（精细细节）vs 高噪声步（全局结构）。logit_normal 通过对数正态分布集中采样中等噪声，等效于关注语义级特征。
advanced.tradeoffs: sigma_sqrt 偏重高噪声步，可能导致全局结构学习更充分但细节稍弱；logit_normal 是当前 SOTA 扩散模型训练的主流选择。

advanced_en.principle: Training loss = E_t[w(t) × ||ε_θ(x_t,t) - ε||²]. The weight function w(t) decides what the model optimizes for: low-noise steps (fine detail) vs high-noise steps (global structure). logit_normal concentrates sampling on medium noise via a log-normal distribution, equivalent to focusing on semantic-level features.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: sigma_sqrt favors high-noise steps — global structure may be learned more fully at slightly weaker detail; logit_normal is the mainstream choice in current SOTA diffusion training.
